method.pack: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts from a scratch package containing the verified dist and the matching source bin, patches, vendor, package.json, README and license
method.install: env -i with private PATH, HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_CACHE_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_STATE_HOME, TMPDIR and LLV_STATE_DIR; bun add -g <packed archive>; find the executable with bun pm bin -g
method.readiness: Wait for the launcher URL banner before GET / returns 200 and the durable retention report exists.
method.stop: SIGINT to the recorded launcher handle, await exit and owned runner cleanup; count every line through shutdown.

modes.repeat: new launcher process with the same private installation and state
modes.journal: changed package, fresh installation with JOURNAL_STREAM=1:1
modes.debug: changed package, fresh installation with DELEGATUS_DEBUG=1

method.terminalNormalization: Capture roots become $SCRATCH; generated process and request UUIDs become resource-N consistently across this document. No terminal line is omitted; other content and measurements are retained.
method.versionNote: Both source packs use the version currently declared on main. The originating published-package report referenced 1.16.0.

journalBlockingWaitProbe.procedure: In two isolated processes, use the production recordBlockingWait with a 300 ms synchronous state-write-lock sample, once per process owner. The CLI journal-mode tests independently verify propagation to both children.
journalBlockingWaitProbe.quietProbe: The same two probes with LLV_QUIET_DIAGNOSTICS=1 exit 0, print zero bytes, and each retains one measurement in blockingWaitDiagnostics().

checks.wrapper: Installed gate-slot.sh; tests, typecheck, lint and package build run sequentially through gate-remote with isolated state. Packed runs use the local owned wrapper with LLV_GATE_RUNNER=off.

verificationHistory.cause: Generated process and request UUIDs were classified as resource identifiers; evidence now uses neutral labels.

earlierFailures: Earlier runs exited 1 on intermittent fixture startup timeouts before either child started. The same early-startup failure reproduced against base production source. The test now waits for its existing Viewer-start marker before probing, avoiding a connection accepted by the CLI temporary port-availability listener. The base-full-with-regressions run also intentionally exercised the new behavior assertions against old production source and exited 1.
selfUpdateCause: Fresh installs have no downloaded-release cache. realpath of the absent release root raised ENOENT and became the summary error. An absent cache is now empty; a file or dangling alias still reports its cause even in quiet mode.
scope: Diagnostic output and the package banner only; measurements remain available. The separate bounded-volume policy is unchanged. No performance improvement is claimed.

mainRecheck.changes: Scanner and pipeline-controller files advanced during verification; none overlap the changed files.
